story_type: first flight of an experimental jet
hook: This jet has no front window. This was its first flight.
narration: This jet has no front window, and this was the first time it ever flew.
October twenty eighth, twenty twenty five. NASA's X-59 took off from Palmdale, California.
Its nose is so long the pilot cannot see straight ahead, so cameras feed him the view on a screen.
Chase jets flew alongside while he ran handling and stability checks, one by one.
Then he flew it to NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center at Edwards to land.
[short pause] Over the radio came the call. Come down. A little more.
outcome: The X-59 touched down at Edwards, and the radio call came back: we're home.
title: Jet with no front window flies first time
description:
On Oct. 28, 2025, NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic research aircraft made its first flight, from Lockheed Martin's Skunk Works in Palmdale, California, to NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California, with taxi, takeoff, handling and stability checks and landing.
